title: Global search box across all entities
description:
Give non-technical users one obvious way in: a prominent global search box (like Wikipedia's) that matches across all node names and key attributes, grouped by entity type in the results (Yachts, Builders, Clubs, Marinas, People, Regions...). Client-side fuzzy/substring search over the in-memory graph with instant results and result counts per type. Clicking a result navigates to that entity's detail page. Keyboard-accessible, works on mobile.

Part of Phase 2 (UI foundation). This is the primary entry point toward the goal: query for specific information without technical knowledge.
acceptance_criteria: A global search box is present on every page and returns results as the user types
Results are grouped by entity type with a count per group and match on name + key attributes
Selecting a result navigates to the corresponding entity detail page
Search is case-insensitive and tolerant of partial words; empty/no-match states are handled gracefully
Search remains responsive on the full graph (thousands of nodes)

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: UAT (delegated to Orchestrator per session loop_auth): all 5 steps PASS — verified by Orchestrator at the human's request. Developer evidence: Playwright/Chromium against live dev server with full graph — search on every route; 'kor'->Koru under Yachts; 'oceanco' name-collision (Builder+Company+21 yachts via builder-name index); case-insensitive; empty state; Enter navigates to /entity/yacht:koru; ArrowDown/Escape/outside-click/'/' shortcut; mobile 375px wrap; 0 console errors. Orchestrator independent check: npm run build green (vue-tsc+vite), /entity/:id route present, search component wired. Visual-polish notes deferred to human review at end.
